thread:
lucy-oncall: incident-bot just paged me: p99 latency jump + 504/GW errors across production clusters, visible starting ~2m ago
incident-bot: ALERT: prod/high-traffic gateway - p99 latency 3.2s -> 12.6s, 504 rate 18% over baseline, affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat (canary tag rc-2026-03-17-46)
nate-sre: grabbing graphs now. I see a correlated deploy at rc-2026-03-17-46 at t-3m. Canary hosts spiking, backend queuing on GPU pool.
sam-platform: dd: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/latency - looks like sustained tail after token 64, KV cache pressure rising
anya-support: getting customer reports: 2 customers reported timeout errors in embeddings and chat sessions (~10m ago they said). Triaging for impact level.
elain-pm: any indication of data corruption or bad responses? Customers asking about data integrity.
jade-eng: quick check: config diff includes a new kernel flag and a batching tweak: 
```
+ runtime.batch.size=dynamic
+ runtime.kv.cache_policy=aggressive
```
Could be causing longer stall while warming KV.
lucy-oncall: Nate, can you confirm whether this is limited to canaries or rolled to prod?
nate-sre: It's in the canary fleet but autoscaler spilled into prod pool due to mis-tagged capacity; ~30% of user traffic hit the canary overlay. So impact is customer-facing.
lucy-oncall: Marking P0 (customer-impacting). Paging oncall rotation. Sam, start mitigation playbook: throttle canary traffic and revert routing to stable.
sam-platform: executing route ban: `route-control set-weight rc-2026-03-17-46 0` -> in progress. Also triggering extra replicas on stable pool for safety.
jade-eng: rolling canary rollback started: `deploy rollback rc-2026-03-17-45` -> applying to all canary nodes. ETA ~2m.
incident-bot: ACTION: rollback job started by jade-eng (job id rb-4449). Notifying watchers.
anya-support: I posted a customer comms draft to #support-ops. Recommend delayed status until rollback shows improvement.
elain-pm: please capture any 5xx examples for postmortem. Want to know any user-visible corrupted outputs.
nate-sre: Observed majority are 504s and timeouts; small percentage 500 with "model decode stalled". No data corruption indicators in logs.
lucy-oncall: Sam, once route weight is 0, confirm p99 and 504 rate. If not back to normal, initiate full rollback of the release across clusters.
sam-platform: route weight set to 0 -> confirmed. Begin draining canary hosts.
(45s pause)
incident-bot: METRICS: p99 latency decreased from 12.6s -> 3.1s in 60s, 504 rate down to 6% (still above baseline).
jade-eng: rollback finished across canary and any mis-tagged prod hosts. Version now rc-2026-03-17-45 everywhere.
nate-sre: trending: p99 now 1.0s, 504s 1.2% steady. Still monitoring double-check for backfill pressure.
anya-support: customer reports patchy improvements; I'm sending an update: "We've identified a canary change causing tail latency, routing reverted, working on full verification."
lucy-oncall: Good. Capture SLO hit and impacted customer IDs for follow-up. Nathan, keep watch for recurrence for 30m.
elain-pm: after metrics stabilize, prepare short postmortem and a remediation list: revert change, add canary isolation checks, guardrail for aggressive KV policy.
jade-eng: opened a rollback revert PR and flagged the batching/kernel tweak with notes.
incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated -> monitoring, duration 00:18. Pager cleared for primary oncall.
lucy-oncall: handing off to Nate for post-incident monitoring and a follow-up sync in 30. @nate-sre you're owner for 30m watch.
nate-sre: Acknowledged. I'll archive related traces and collect top 10 slow traces and request IDs for postmortem.
anya-support: I'll compile list of customers who reported issues and coordinate comms.
elain-pm: schedule quick blameless sync in 1h to decide rollout policy.
lucy-oncall: Thanks everyone. Closing chat thread once metrics hold. :thumbsup:
